visual_elements.description: Scatter plot with no axis labels or tick marks; red/maroon L-shaped axes (vertical arrow up, horizontal arrow right). Three clusters of filled circular points: a green cluster of ~10 points in the middle-left rising diagonally; a cyan cluster of ~8 points in the upper-middle/right; a beige/tan cluster of ~6 points at the bottom-center. One large red filled circle sits at the far left near the y-axis (overlapping the green cluster's left edge), and a smaller red dot with a red '?' to its right sits in the center between the green and beige clusters, representing the test sample.
Yellow highlight behind the words 'ONE TEST' in the bottom caption
Small circle containing the number '43' (slide number badge)

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout; title is large and bold with two colors (dark red for 'Nearest Neighbors', blue for '(NN) Example'); caption is smaller bold dark-red text; '?' is bold red italic-ish; no numbered bullets.

Inside, left half: draw red L-shaped axes with arrowheads (up and right), no ticks or labels. 7. Scatter filled circles: ~10 green (#7ED957) points forming a diagonal cluster middle-left; ~8 cyan (#2FE0E0) points upper-center-right; ~6 beige (#E8C9A0) points bottom-center. 8. Place one large red (#E02020) filled circle at the far left near the y-axis, and a smaller red dot mid-center with a red bold '?' immediately to its right. 9. Bottom-left caption in bold dark red: 'Data of Three Classes   and ONE TEST sample', with a yellow (#FFFF00) highlight behind 'ONE TEST'.
